snap_down_object: snap a rigid object down onto a support surface using raycasting in the Habitat simulator
get_all_objects_and_ids: get all objects and their IDs from the simulator including rigid and articulated objects
query_spatial_prepositions: query spatial relationships like above, within, ontop, on_floor, and next_to between objects in the scene
open_close_articulated_links: open, close, or set the normalized joint position of articulated object links like doors and drawers
check_object_region_containment: check if an object is contained within a semantic scene region and get the containment ratio
